zac.why: P's resurrection-into-bloblets only triggers on fatal damage, which a dummy that never fights back can never deal, so the pet system never appears in this fight and P reduces to pure healing/cosmetics. Q's dual-target displacement/slam bonus likewise needs two different targets that don't exist here, leaving a plain empowered-attack combo; the remaining pieces (W's chunk-fed cooldown reduction, E's charge-release, R's multi-bounce) are standard combinations.
